column1: # Store release-note lines for pull requests whose titles don't read well in a store
# listing. One per line: PR number, a tab, then the line, or "none" to leave the
# PR out of the store notes (it still appears in the GitHub release).
# apple/bin/release-notes.py reads this; a "Release note: ..." line in a PR's
# description does the same for new PRs. Identical lines for the two apps'
# versions of a feature are listed once.
